en-e1-l1.title: Alfabeetada iyo codka hore
en-e1-l1.concept: Erayga way fududahay in la xasuusto haddii la ogyahay codkiisa hore iyo xarafkiisa hore. Cod ka bixi oo raac akhriska.

en-e1-l2.title: Salaamaha
en-e1-l2.concept: Marka aad la kulanto dad waxaad tidhaahdaa **Hello**, marka la kala tago waxaa la yiraahdaa **Goodbye**. Magacaaga waxaad ku sheegaysaa **My name is ...**.

en-e1-l3.title: Tirooyinka iyo midabada
en-e1-l3.concept: Baro one, two, three... tirooyinka iyo red, blue, yellow... erayada midabada.

en-e1-l4.title: Qoyska
en-e1-l4.concept: Kuwani waa erayada loo yeedho xubnaha qoyska, sida mother (hooyo), father (aabbe), grandmother (ayeeyo), baby (ilmo yar).

en-e1-l5.title: Erayada fasalka
en-e1-l5.concept: desk, chair, bag, pencil, book... Ku dheh Ingiriisi erayada fasalka lagu isticmaalo.

en-e2-l1.title: Magacyada xayawaanka iyo alaabta
en-e2-l1.concept: Erayada magac muujiya sida rabbit (diiq), bird (shimbir), fish (kalluun) waxaa la yiraahdaa **magac**.

en-e2-l2.title: Erayada dhaqdhaqaaqa
en-e2-l2.concept: Erayada dhaqdhaqaaq muujiya sida jump (bood), run (orod), eat (cun) waxaa la yiraahdaa **fal**.

en-e2-l3.concept: **I like ...** waxay ka dhigan tahay 'Waan jeclahay ...', **I have ...** waxay ka dhigan tahay 'Waxaan haystaa ...'.

en-e2-l4.title: Samaynta weedhaha gaagaaban
en-e2-l4.concept: Ka dib I waxaa la isticmaalaa **am**, ka dib You waxaa la isticmaalaa **are**. Weedhu waxay u socotaa 'yaa → sidee yahay/maxay sameeyaa'.

en-e2-l5.title: Akhriska qoraalka gaaban
en-e2-l5.concept: Marka aad qoraal akhrinayso, marka hore ka raadi erayada su'aasha qoraalka.

en-e3-abc1.title: Xarfaha waaweyn iyo yaryar ee alfabeetada
en-e3-abc1.concept: Alfabeetadu waxay leedahay **xarfo waaweyn** iyo **xarfo yaryar**. Waxaa jira lamaane badan oo qaab ahaan kala duwan, sidaas darteed mid mid ugu xasuuso lamaane. Si gaar ah ugu taxadar xarfaha isku eg sida b, d, p, q.

en-e3-l1.title: Samaynta weedhaha
en-e3-l1.concept: Weedhu waxay u socotaa 'yaa → maxay sameeyaa → maxay'. Falka ka dambeeya He, She, iyo magaca qofka waxaa lagu daraa **-s**.

en-e3-l3.title: Wakhtiga hadda iyo wakhtigii hore
en-e3-l3.concept: Wax hadda socda ama soo noqnoqda waxaa loo isticmaalaa **wakhtiga hadda**; wax hore u dhacay waxaa loo isticmaalaa **wakhtigii hore**, oo falka dhammaadkiisa lagu daro **-ed**.

en-e3-l4.title: Jadwalka maalinlaha ah
en-e3-l4.concept: get up, brush my teeth, eat breakfast, go to bed... Ku dheh Ingiriisi jadwalkaaga maalinlaha ah.

en-e3-l5.title: Fahamka qoraalka
en-e3-l5.concept: Qoraalka akhri oo raadi yaa, goorma, iyo maxay sameeyeen.

en-e3-snd1.title: Xiriirka dhawaaqa iyo higgaadda
en-e3-snd1.concept: Dhawaaqa hore ee erayga iyo xarafka hore way xiriiraan. Raadi erayo ku bilaabma isla dhawaaq si aad u barato xiriirka dhawaaqa iyo higgaadda. Laba xaraf sida ph ayaa mararka qaarkood sameeya dhawaaqa f.

en-e4-l1.title: Hadda · hore · mustaqbal
en-e4-l1.concept: Wax hadda iyo mid is-celceliya waxaa lagu sheegaa **wakhtiga hadda**, wax hore **-ed**, wax mustaqbalka ah **will + ficil aasaas ah**.

en-e4-l2.title: Weedho su'aal iyo diidmo
en-e4-l2.concept: Weedhaha su'aasha waxay ku bilaabmaan **Do/Does**, marka la yiraahdo maya waxaa la isticmaalaa **don't/doesn't**.

en-e4-l3.title: Erayada muujinaya qaab iyo dareen
en-e4-l3.concept: Waa erayo sharaxa muuqaal ama dareen, sida big (weyn), small (yar), hot (kulul), cold (qabow).

en-e4-l4.title: Erayada muujinaya goob
en-e4-l4.concept: Waxaad ku sheegtaa meesha shay ku yaal **on** (kor), **in** (gudaha), **under** (hoos), **behind** (gadaal).

en-e4-l5.title: Akhrinta qoraal gaaban
en-e4-l5.concept: Ka raadi qoraalka cidda, meesha iyo wixii la sameeyey, kadibna jawaab.

en-e5-l1.title: Qodobbada, jamac iyo There is/are
en-e5-l1.concept: Hortiisa dhawaaq shaqal ah isticmaal **an**, hortiisa dhawaaq shibbane ah isticmaal **a**. Haddii uu yahay hal isticmaal **There is**, haddii ay yihiin dhawr isticmaal **There are**.

en-e5-l2.title: Erayada barbar-dhigga
en-e5-l2.concept: Marka laba la barbar dhigayo isticmaal **-er + than**, wixii ugu ... ah isticmaal **the -est**. Erayada dhaadheer isticmaal **more**.

en-e5-l3.title: Qaababka mustaqbalka
en-e5-l3.concept: Wax mustaqbalka ah waxaa lagu sheegaa **will + ficil aasaas ah** ama **be going to + ficil aasaas ah**.

en-e5-l4.title: Dib-u-qorista weedhaha
en-e5-l4.concept: Weedhaha diidmada, hortooda ku qor **not / don't / doesn't / didn't**; weedhaha su'aasha, hortooda ku qor **Are / Do / Does**.

en-e5-l5.title: Fahamka qoraalka
en-e5-l5.concept: Qoraal dheer, haddii aad ka raadiso cidda, meesha, goorta iyo wixii sida hoosta looga xariiqayo, way fududaataa akhrintiisu.

en-e6-l1.title: Dulmar guud oo wakhtiyada
en-e6-l1.concept: Wax hadda socda waxaa lagu sheegaa **be + -ing**, wax hore **qaabka wakhtiga hore**, wax mustaqbalka ah **will / be going to**.

en-e6-l2.concept: Ka dib **can** (karo), **must** (waa inay), **should** (wanaagsan in), **may** (la oggol yahay) waxaa yimaada ficil aasaas ah.

en-e6-l3.title: Balaarinta erayada
en-e6-l3.concept: Haddii aad wada barato erayo isku macne ah iyo kuwa ka soo horjeeda, erayadaadu waxay noqonayaan laba jeer.

en-e6-l4.title: Erayada isku xidha
en-e6-l4.concept: Weedhaha waxaa lagu xidhaa **because** (sabab), **so** (natiijo), **but** (ka soo horjeed), **if** (haddii), **when** (markii).

en-e6-l5.title: Akhrinta cutub
en-e6-l5.concept: Akhri qoraal ka kooban dhawr weedhood oo ka raadi cidda, goorta iyo sababta wax loo sameeyey, kadibna jawaab.

en-e6-pun1.title: Xarfaha waaweyn iyo calaamadaha qoraalka
en-e6-pun1.concept: Weedhuhu waxay ku bilaabmaan **xaraf weyn** dhammaadkana waxay leeyihiin **calaamad qoraal** ku habboon. Weedho caadi ah dhibic (.), su'aal calaamadda su'aasha (?), la yaab ama dareen xooggan calaamadda la yaabka (!). Magacyada dadka iyo I had iyo jeer waa xaraf weyn.

en-e6-seq1.title: Garashada isku-xigga dhacdooyinka
en-e6-seq1.concept: Haddii aad raadiso erayada tilmaamaya isku-xigga sida **First** (marka hore), **Then / Next** (kadib), **After that** (intaas ka dib), **Finally** (ugu dambayn), waad ogaan kartaa sida wax u dhaceen.

en-h1-l1.title: Wakhtiyada dhammaystiran iyo socodka dhammaystiran
en-h1-l1.concept: had + p.p. waa wax ka hor dhacay wakhtiga hore, have been -ing waa ficil ilaa hadda sii socda.

en-h1-l2.title: Magac-bedelka xiriirka tilmaamaha iyo weedhaha magaca
en-h1-l2.concept: where / when / why waa erayada xiriirka oo ka shaqeeya sida tilmaame, whether / that-na waxay keenaan weedho magac ah.

en-h1-l3.title: Dhismaha lahaanshaha-hadda (participle)
en-h1-l3.concept: Ka gaabi erayga isku xidha iyo mawduuca, falkana u beddel -ing. Mawduucyada macnaha waa inay isku mid noqdaan.

en-h1-l4.title: Erayada isku xidha iyo socodka qoraalka
en-h1-l4.concept: Kala sooc sabab–natiijo (so, therefore), isbarbar-dhig (however), tusaale (for example), dheeraad (in addition).

en-h1-l5.title: Fahmidda fikradda iyo qiyaasidda meesha banaan
en-h1-l5.concept: Fikradda ugu weyni waxay ku jirtaa wixii ka dambeeya However ee beddela fikradda caadiga ah iyo weedha ugu dambeysa. Meesha banaan ku qiyaas socodka dhibaato → xal → natiijo.

en-h2-l1.title: Rogidda iyo xoojinta dhismaha
en-h2-l1.concept: Marka Never/Hardly/Only then ay timaado bilowga weedha, tartiibku waa fal-caawiye + mawduuc. Waxaa lagu xoojiyaa It is ~ that.

en-h2-l2.title: Male-awaalka (subjunctive)
en-h2-l2.concept: Weedhaha I wish / as if / If, lidka xaqiiqada hadda isticmaal wakhtigii hore, lidka xaqiiqada hore isticmaal had p.p.

en-h2-l3.title: Magac-bedelka isku-dhafan iyo weedhaha oggolaanshaha
en-h2-l3.concept: whatever, whoever, whichever, however + tilmaame macnahooda waa 'kasta oo', 'si kasta ha ...'.

en-h2-l4.title: Erayada macnaha weedha ku jira
en-h2-l4.concept: Tilmaamaha isbarbar-dhigga, tusaalaha, sababta iyo horgalayaasha ayaa lagu qiyaasaa macnaha erayga aan la aqoon.

en-h2-l5.title: Horumarinta caqliga qoraalka
en-h2-l5.concept: Raac socodka qoraalka adigoo isticmaalaya waxa ay tilmaamayaan erayada tilmaamaha iyo erayada isku xidha, kaddib ururi faahfaahinta si aad gabagabada u qabato.

en-h3-l1.title: Dhismaha isbarbar socda iyo is-waafaqidda tirada
en-h3-l1.concept: Odhaahyada ay isku xidhaan and/but/or waa inay isku qaab noqdaan, falkuna wuxuu waafaqaa mawduuca ugu muhiimsan.

en-h3-l2.title: Jawiga, hadalka iyo ujeeddada
en-h3-l2.concept: Jawiga waxaa lagu garanayaa erayada sharaxaadda iyo dareenka, ujeeddada qoraalkana waxaa lagu garanayaa inuu codsi, tilmaam ama ku qanciyo yahay.

en-h3-l3.title: Kala horreynta weedhaha iyo gelinta
en-h3-l3.concept: Weedhaha ku habee adigoo isticmaalaya erayada isku xidha, erayada tilmaamaha iyo kala horreynta waqtiga, kaddib raadi halka weedha la bixiyey ku habboon tahay.

en-h3-l4.title: Erayada wada socda iyo odhaahyada caadiga ah
en-h3-l4.concept: Baro lammaanayaasha wada isticmaalka sida make a decision, take a risk, heavy rain, odhaahyada caadiga ahna macnahooda ka qiyaas xaaladda.
en-h3-l4.example: the last straw = xadka ugu dambeeya ee samirka

en-h3-l5.title: Dhammaystirka weedha soo koobidda
en-h3-l5.concept: Raadi fikradaha muhiimka ah iyo erayada isbarbar-dhigga ee qoraalka, kuna soo gaabi hal weedh.

en-h3e-l1.title: Dooridda hadalka ku habboon xaaladda
en-h3e-l1.concept: Su'aalaha wada-hadalka, ka sokow naxwaha saxda ah, waa inaad eegtaa in hadalku yahay mid dabiici ah oo dhaqan ahaan ixtiraam leh xaaladdaas. Soo jeedin, hakin, ka jawaabidda ammaan, odhaahyada caadiga ah, iyo hadal dhadhan-dhig ah ayaa inta badan yimaada.

en-h3e-l2.title: Odhaahyada shaqada iyo erayada wada socda
en-h3e-l2.concept: Ingiriisiga shaqadu wuxuu ku xidhan yahay odhaahyada caadiga ah (touch base), soo gaabinta (ASAP iwm), iyo lammaanayaasha fal iyo horgale (erayada wada socda). Ha u tarjumin erayada si toos ah; ku xasuuso sida qaybo loo isticmaalo xaaladaha shaqada.

en-h3e-l3.title: Akhrinta macluumaadka si dhaleeceyn leh
en-h3e-l3.concept: Ingiriisiga warbaahinta, waa muhiim in aad kala saarto xaqiiqooyinka iyo ra'yiga, oo aad hubiso in caqliga loo adeegsaday sheegashada uu ku habboon yahay. Erayada sida sharaxaadda sawirka (alt text, caption) ama qalabka tafatirka ku xasuuso ujeeddadooda.

en-h3e-l4.title: Erayada dhaqanka iyo dabeecadda furan
en-h3e-l4.concept: Mawduucyada dhaqamada adduunka, baro erayada muhiimka ah sida culture, diversity, stereotype, iyo odhaahyada isku dayaya inay fahmaan dhaqamada kale iyaga oo aan xukumin. Erayada macnaha isku eg kala sooc tilmaamaha macnaha.

en-h3e-l5.title: Akhrinta shuqullada adoo adeegsanaya erayada suugaanta
en-h3e-l5.concept: Su'aalaha suugaanta, furaha waa inaad ogaato qeexidda erayga oo aad ku dabaqdo muuqaallada sheekada. Kala sooc foreshadowing, astaan, aragti, mawduuc, iyo door-qaadashada jilaaga.

en-h3e-l6.title: Kala saarista caddaymaha iyo khaladaadka
en-h3e-l6.concept: Doodda, waxaad u baahan tahay awood aad ku kala saarto erayada (motion, rebuttal iwm), noocyada caddaynta, iyo khaladaadka caqliga. Marka aad qiimeyneyso sheegasho, marka hore weydii ‘waa maxay caddaynta hadalkan?’.

en-h3e-l7.title: Qoris sax ah oo ujeeddada waafaqsan
en-h3e-l7.concept: Qorista, dooro qaab ku habboon ujeeddada qoraalka iyo akhristaha, hubina qaybaha weedha (mawduuc iyo fal) iyo caqliga erayada isku xidha. Qoraalada gaarka ah sida CV-ga, waxqabadyo iyo tirooyin ayaa ka wanaagsan hadal aan cadayn.

en-l1.title: Barashada erayada maalinlaha ah
en-l1.concept: Erayada inta badan la isticmaalo, haddii aad wada barato **cod + macne + qoris**, waa lagu xasuustaa muddo dheer. Badhanka dhawaaqa riix si aad u dhegaysato dhawaaqa.
en-l1.example: library = maktabad / desk = miis / milk = caano

en-l2.title: Falka be: am / are / is
en-l2.concept: Falka be wuxuu u beddelmaa sida mawduucu yahay. **I → am**, **he / she / it → is**, **you / we / they → are**.

en-l3.title: Falalka caadiga ah ee wakhtiga hadda
en-l3.concept: Marka mawduucu yahay **he / she / it (qofka saddexaad, keliya)**, falka ku dar **-s / -es**. Haddii ku dhammaado -ch, -sh, -s, -x, -o, -es; shibbane+y, y u beddel i oo ku dar -es!

en-l4.title: Qaabka jamaca iyo samaynta weedho
en-l4.concept: Marka magacu yahay laba ama ka badan inta badan ku dar **-s**, haddii ku dhammaado -x, **-es**, jamacyada aan caadiga ahayn gooni u xasuuso. Weedhu waxay u socotaa **mawduuc → fal → inta kale**.

en-m2-l1.title: Wakhtiga hadda-dhammaaday
en-m2-l1.concept: have/has + lahaanshaha-hore. Wuxuu muujiyaa khibrad, dhammaad iyo sii socod, kala sooc since (bilow wakhti) iyo for (muddo).

en-m2-l2.title: Dhaqdhaqaaqa-la-sameeyay
en-m2-l2.concept: be + lahaanshaha-hore wuxuu muujiyaa ‘la sameeyay/lagu sameeyay’. Sameeyaha waxaa lagu daraa by.

en-m2-l3.title: To-infinitive iyo gerund
en-m2-l3.concept: want, hope, decide + to-infinitive, enjoy, finish, avoid + gerund. stop + to V waa ujeeddo, stop + V-ing waa joojin.

en-m2-l4.title: Darajada isbarbar-dhigga iyo ugu sarreysa
en-m2-l4.concept: -er/-est iyo more/most. Isbarbar-dhigga la isticmaal than, ugu sarreysa la isticmaal the. good → better → best waa aan caadi ahayn.

en-m2-l5.title: Akhris: mawduuca iyo faahfaahinta
en-m2-l5.concept: Marka hore akhri su'aasha oo raadi weedhaha tilmaamaha. Cinwaanka iyo fikradda ugu weyn waa waxa dhammaan qoraalka koobaya.

en-m2-sum1.title: Soo koobidda qoraalka
en-m2-sum1.concept: Marka qoraal la soo koobayo, raadi **macnaha dhexe** oo ku soo gaabi hal ama laba weedh. Weedho sheegaya hal faahfaahin oo keliya, ku daraya wax aan qoraalka ku jirin, ama aad u ballaadhan ma aha soo koobid wanaagsan.

en-m3-l1.title: Magac-bedelka xidhiidhka
en-m3-l1.concept: who (qof), which (shay), that (labadaba), whose (lahaansho) ayaa lagu xidhaa laba weedh hal weedh.

en-m3-l2.title: Weedhaha shuruudda iyo male-awaalka hore
en-m3-l2.concept: If + hadda, will + V (wax suurtagal ah). If + hore, would + V (male-awaal lid ku ah xaqiiqada hadda).

en-m3-l3.title: Weedhaha su'aalaha aan toos ahayn
en-m3-l3.concept: Qor tartiibka erayga su'aasha + mawduuc + fal. do/does/did lama isticmaalo.

en-m3-l4.title: Falxiraalaha (participles)
en-m3-l4.concept: -ing waa firfircoon iyo socda, -ed waa dhacdo iyo dhammaystiran. Dareenka: haddii wax kicinayo waa -ing, haddii la dareemayo waa -ed.

en-m3-l5.title: Akhris: ka-soo-gaabin iyo ujeedada qoraalka

Ka fikir socodka dabiiciga ah ee ka dambeeya jumladda hore ee ah 'lix saacadood ayaan shaqeeyey'.

e-h3e-conv-5.explanation: Jawaabtu waa in la weydiisto in daaqadda la xidho ama kulayl la kordhiyo. Waxay u egtahay hadal cimilo ah, laakiin dhab ahaan waa codsi jilicsan. Doorashooyinka sharxaya saadaasha cimilada ama weydiinaya meesha thermometer-ku yaal waa khalad maxaa yeelay waxay raacaan macnaha dhabta ah ee erayada oo keliya.
hints: Hadalka si aan toos ahayn loo yiri, ka fikir waxa qofka hadlaya uu rabo in la sameeyo xaaladdaas, ee ha eegin macnaha erayada oo keliya.
Eeg waxa ay tahay tallaabada dhibaatada xallinaysa ee marti qabow ku jirta qolka ay rajeyn laheyd mulkiilaha guriga.

e-h3e-conv-d1.explanation: “Your ideas are strong; maybe the ending could be a bit clearer.” waa tactful sababtoo ah waxay marka hore sheegaysaa xooggooda, ka dibna soo jeedinta waxay ku siinaysaa erayo jilicsan sida maybe, a bit. “Your ending is terrible...” waa daacad laakiin si toos ah ayay u eedaysaa qofka, sidaas darteed waa edeb daro.
hints: tactful waa inaad hadasho adigoo aan dareenka qofka kale ku dhaawacin. Raadi jumlad daacad ah laakiin jilicsan.
Doorasho kasta barbar dhig in ay qirayso xooggaga saaxiibka, iyo codka ay ku sheegto waxa la hagaajin karo.

e-h3e-debate-1.explanation: Jawaabtu waa Bandwagon appeal. Waa khalad saamaynta ficil-raaca maxaa yeelay waxay u aragtaa wax sax ah oo keliya sababtoo ah dad badan ayaa sameeya. Hasty generalization waa khalad ku saabsan guud-ka-qaadis degdeg ah oo ku salaysan tusaalayaal yar, sidaas darteed way ka duwan tahay udub-dhexaadka jumladdan.
hints: Su'aalaha khaladka, marka hore weydii in sababta sheegashadu tahay caddayn mise wax kale.
Barbar dhig sababta ah 'qof walba way sameeyaan' oo loo isticmaalay sheegashada la caddaynayo macnaha magac-khalad kasta.

e-h3e-debate-2.explanation: Jawaabtu waa The park, which opened in May, covers four hectares. Waxay ka kooban tahay xaqiiqooyin la hubin karo oo kaliya: waqtiga furitaanka iyo cabbirka. best thing the council has ever done waa qiimayn, sidaas darteed waa aragti shakhsi ah.
hints: Weedh hadaf ahi waxay ka kooban tahay macluumaad qof walba hubin karo oo kaliya, qiimayn ama dareen la'aan.
Weed kasta ka raadi erayo sida wonderful, fool, best oo muujinaya qiimayn ama dareen.

e-h3e-debate-3.explanation: Jawaabtu waa motion. Waa hadalka mawduuca doodda ah. rebuttal waa celinta doodda dhinaca kale, sidaas darteed ma aha mawduucii laftiisa.
hints: Erayada doodda waxaa lagu kala saaraa doorka ay doodda ku leeyihiin.
Is barbar dhig waxa ‘hadalka labada kooxood ku murmaan’ tilmaamayo iyo erayada ka dhigan celin, xukun iyo diiwaan.

e-h3e-debate-4.explanation: Jawaabtu waa Statistical evidence. Waa sababta ah tirooyinku waxay ka yimaadeen su'aalo la weydiiyay dad badan. Anecdotal evidence waa waayo-aragnimada hal ama laba qof, sidaas darteed way ka duwan tahay sahankan.
hints: Nooca caddaynta waxaa lagu kala saaraa il-bixinta macluumaadka: khabiir, waayo-aragnimo shakhsi ah, mala-awaal, tirooyin iwm.
Eeg sida cabbirka muunadda (2,000 qof) iyo boqolleyda (64%) u tilmaamayaan nooca caddaynta.

e-h3e-debate-5.explanation: Jawaabtu waa persuasive. Ka dib be, meesha madhan waxaa u taal tilmaame sharxaya shayga, sidaas darteed waxaa lagu isticmaalaa tilmaame. persuasively waa falaad-sharaxe, sidaas darteed ma sharxi karto speech.
hints: Marka hore go'aami nooca eraygu yahay meesha madhan. Isku xigxiga erayadu nooc noocee ah ayuu doonayaa?
Hubi in ‘was highly ___’ ay tahay meel lagu sharxayo speech, kadibna dooro nooca ku habboon.

e-h3e-debate-d1.explanation: Qofku wuxuu diidayaa soo jeedinta isagoo ku saleynaya waxa Lena hore u samaysay, ee ma aha waxa soo jeedintu ka kooban tahay, sidaas darteed waa ad hominem (weerar shakhsi ah). straw man waa in doodda dhinaca kale la qalloociyo si loo weeraro, laakiin halkan soo jeedintii lama qalloociyin.
hints: Su'aasha khalad-fikirka waxaa laga bilaabaa in la eego waxa la dhaleecaynayo: doodda lafteeda mise wax kale?
Eeg in hadlaha uu dooddayo waxa ku jira soo jeedinta recycling ee Lena, mise uu isticmaalayo xaqiiqooyin kale oo Lena ku saabsan.

e-h3e-job-1.explanation: Jawaabtu waa in si kooban loo wada xiriiro si loo wadaago xaaladda. touch base waxaa la isticmaalaa marka si kooban loo la xiriiro si war loo wadaago. Haddii aad ka fikirto ciyaar sababta oo ah erayga base, waad khaldami doontaa.
hints: Hadallada goobta shaqada waa wax iska qarsoon haddii erayo-erayo lagu tarjumo. Marka hore ka fikir xaaladda shaqo ee loo isticmaalo.
Eeg in kaaga shaqada uu yiri ‘toddobaadka soo socda’ iyo waxa wadahadalka shaqada lagu soo jeedinayo in la sameeyo.

e-h3e-job-2.explanation: Jawaabtu waa postponed. Macnaheedu waa in kulanka dib loo dhigay, sidaas darteed wuxuu la socdaa until next Monday. finished macnaheedu waa in kulanku dhammaaday, taas oo aan la jaan qaadayn ‘ilaa Isniinta soo socota’.
hints: Eeg waxa sababta iyo waqtiga weedha ay keenayaan.
Hubi in isbeddelka jadwalku ku habboon yahay sababta ah in maamuluhu buka iyo wakhtiga ilaa Isniinta soo socota.

e-h3e-job-3.explanation: Jawaabtu waa out. run out of macnaheedu waa ‘wax ka dhammaaday’. away ama off waxay la dhici karaan run, laakiin ma sameeyaan macnahan ku xiran of.
hints: Ka fikir xaaladda ay muujinayaan running ka hor, of ka dib, iyo printer paper ka dib. Mid mid u geli afarta eray oo dhageyso in 'running ___ of ...' ay u dhawaaqayso mid dabiici ah.
Sababta oo ah weedha xigta waxay tiri waraaqo dheeraad ah dalbo, ka fikir xaaladda waraaqaha.

e-h3e-job-4.explanation: Jawaabtu waa at. be good at ~ing waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu sheego awood. good of waxaa loo isticmaalaa in lagu ammaano ficilka qof, sida ‘aad ayaad u roon tahay’, sidaas darteed ma aha weedh awood.
hints: Hubi eraybixinta ku xiga tilmaame good iyadoo la eegayo erayada isla raaca.
Sababta oo ah solving waa magac-fal ing leh oo ku xiga, raadi eraybixinta lagu sheego awoodda ‘wax samaynta’.

e-h3e-job-5.explanation: Jawaabtu waa for your information. Macnaheedu waa ‘waan ku ogeysiinayaa’, waxaana inta badan lagu isticmaalaa email. for your invitation waxay la mid tahay F iyo Y, laakiin I waxay noqonaysaa casuumaad, sidaas darteed macnuhu wuu ka duwan yahay.
hints: Soo gaabinta, ku fidi xarfaha erayo ay ka bilaabmaan oo hubi in ay la jaan qaadayaan ujeedada la dhigayo hortiisa fariinta.
Ujeedadu waa in qof la ogeysiiyo marka hore. Is barbar dhig erayada ku bilaabma F, Y iyo I.

e-h3e-job-d1.explanation: Erayga ku xiga meesha banaan, person, waa magac (noun), sidaa darteed eray-raaca reliable (la isku halayn karo) ayaa saxan. reliably waa falcelis (adverb), sidaa darteed ma sifayn karo magac.
hints: Afartu erey waxay ka yimaadeen xidid isku mid ah, sidaa darteed nooca eraygu ayaa muhiim ah, ma aha micnaha. Marka hore go'aami door ay meesha banaani ku leedahay jumladda.
Hubi nooca eraygu ku xiga meesha banaan, oo ka fikir nooca eray ee sifeeya.

e-h3e-lit-1.explanation: Jawaabtu waa foreshadowing (horyaal). Waa aalad horay u tilmaamta waxa dhici doona. flashback waa ku noqoshada goob hore, sidaa darteed ma aha tilmaan wax dhici doona.
hints: Ereyada suugaanta ku xasuuso qeexitaanka oo ku dabaq socodka sheekada. Aaladdani waxay shaqeysaa goorma sheekada dhexdeeda?
Eeg isku xigga waqtiga marka la sheego in buundadu daciifto iyo marka ay dumaysay.

e-h3e-lit-2.explanation: Jawaabtu waa peace. Qoolleyda cad waa astaan dhaqameed oo nabadda ah suugaanta. danger kuma habboona goobta dagaalka ka dib.
hints: Gabayada, xayawaanka ama walxuhu waxay noqon karaan astaamo. Ku xidh jawiga goobta.
Ka fikir xaaladda dadku rabaan dagaalka ka dib, kadibna raadi erayga ku habboon.

e-h3e-lit-3.explanation: Jawaabtu waa omniscient (wax walba og) point of view. Waxay ogtahay fikirka dad badan. limited point of view waxay tusaysaa fikirka hal qof, sidaa darteed kuma habboona tusaalaha ay ku jiraan fikirka laba qof.
hints: Su'aalaha point of view waxay eegaan yaa hadlaya iyo inta qof ee ay soo-jeediyuhu ogyahay fikirkooda.
Hubi in tusaalaha lagu sheegay fikirka Anna iyo Tom labadoodaba, kadibna dooro point of view ku habboon.

e-h3e-lit-4.explanation: Jawaabtu waa Kindness often comes back to those who give it. Waxay sheekada sababta iyo natiijada ku sheegtaa fikrad guud oo nolosha ku saabsan. The story takes place in a market waa sharaxaad goob oo kaliya, ma aha theme.
hints: Theme maaha qaabka sheekada ama goobta, ee waa fikrad guud oo sheekadu ka sheegayso nolosha.
Hubi in jumladdu isku soo koobayso xiriirka ficilka wiilka iyo natiijadiisa, oo aanay sheekada ka hor imanin.

e-h3e-lit-5.explanation: Jawaabtu waa protagonist (jilaa ugu weyn). Waa kan sheekada dhexda ku jira, hadaf leh, oo ficillada hoggaamiya. antagonist waa qofka ka hor jooga protagonist, sidaa darteed doorkiisu waa ka soo horjeeda.
hints: Ereyada jilaaga waxaa lagu kala saaraa door. Jilaaga weyn, kan ka soo horjeeda, iyo kan sheekada sheegaya way kala duwan yihiin.
U barbar dhig sharaxaadda 'wants something and drives the action' ee su'aasha qeexitaanka eray kasta.

e-h3e-lit-d1.explanation: Qaabka si joogto ah u soo noqnoqda ee eray-kudhacyada la xooggeeyay iyo kuwa aan la xooggeynin waa rhythm (meter). plot structure waa isku xigga dhacdooyinka, la xiriir ma laha dhawaaqa.
hints: Qeexitaanka su'aasha (stressed and unstressed syllables, regular pattern) ku qor erayadaada, kadibna dooro doorashada ku habboon.
Haddii stressed iyo unstressed syllables is beddelaan, maxay u dhawaaqaan? Raadi erayga muujinaya dareenkaas.

e-h3e-media-1.explanation: Jawaabtu waa in sawirka loo sharaxo dadka aan arki karin. Alt text waxay macluumaadka siisaa barnaamijyada akhriya shaashadda ama marka sawirku muuqan waayo. Ka hortagga koobiyeynta waa shaqada tignoolajiyo kale.
hints: Fasax magaca erayga. alt waa soo-gaabin ah alternative (beddel).
Ka fikir kuwa uu qaybtani caawiyo iyo xaaladaha, kadibna ka tirtir doorashooyinka ka fog ujeeddada.

e-h3e-media-2.explanation: Jawaabtu waa The new park is the most beautiful place in town. 'Ugu quruxda badan' waa qiimeyn qof walba ka duwan tahay, sidaa darteed waa ra'yi. Bisha furitaanka, baaxadda, iyo tirada goobaha cayaarta waa xaqiiqooyin la xaqiijin karo.
hints: Xaqiiqooyinka waa la xaqiijin karaa, ra'yigu qof walba wuu ka duwan yahay. Eeg in jumlad kastaa la hubin karo.
Eeg in macluumaadka sida taariikhda, baaxadda, tirada la xaqiijin karo, ama jumladdu ay ereyo qiimeyn ah ku jiraan.

e-h3e-media-3.explanation: Jawaabtu waa in ay u malaynayso in shaahu yahay sababta wanaagsanaanta. Ka caafimaadka ka dib cabbidda shaaha macnaheedu ma aha in shaahu sabab u yahay. formal style waa qaab qoraal oo kaliya, ma aha daciifnimo ka jirta fikirka.
hints: Ku soo koob hal sadar waxa xajistaanka ay ka gudbayso iyo gabagabada ay gaadhayso. Kadib is weydii in caddaynta keligeed ay ku filan tahay gabagabadaas. Hubi in doorashadu ka hadlayso xiriirka fikirka mise muuqaalka qoraalka oo kaliya.
Diiradda saar sida xiriirka u dhexeeya cabbidda shaaha iyo wanaagsanaanta loogu gaadhay gabagabada, oo ka saar doorashooyinka ka hadlaya erayada ama qaabka qoraalka.

e-h3e-media-4.explanation: Jawaabtu waa Students gather with balloons at the annual school fair. Ardayda, buufinnada iyo munaasabadda dugsiga dhammaantood waxay ku habboon yihiin sawirka. Doorashada sida orodyahan keligiis dhammaadka marinaya aad bay uga duwan tahay sawirka.
hints: Qoraalka sawirku wuxuu ku tilmaami waa dadka, meelaha iyo ficillada sawirka ka muuqda.
Marka hore qor dadka, meesha iyo alaabta muuqda, kadibna la barbar dhig doorasho kasta si aad u aragto intay isku mid yihiin.

e-h3e-media-5.explanation: Jawaabtu waa Track changes. Waxay muujisaa isbeddellada waxayna soo bandhigtaa soo jeedinno wax-ka-beddel iyada oo aan tirtirin qoraalka asalka ah. Print preview waxay kaliya tusaysaa sida uu u muuqan doono marka la daabaco, sidaas darteed uma dhigna soo jeedin tafatir.
hints: Qor shuruudaha aad rabto. Waa in wax-ka-beddel la soo jeediyo laakiin aan la tirtirin qoraalka asalka ah.
Hubi in doorasho kasta ay la xiriirto tafatirka dukumeentiga, haddii ay la xiriirto, in ay ilaalinayso qoraalka asalka ah iyadoo muujinaysa isbeddellada.

e-h3e-media-d1.explanation: echo chamber waxaa loola jeedaa koox mar walba maqasha fikrado la mid ah kuwooda, sidaas darteed fikirkoodu wuu xoogaysanayaa. Qolka sheekada ee fariinta labo jeer ku celiya waxay si toos ah u celinaysaa codka ama qoraalka, lagana xiriiro eex ra'yi.
hints: echo chamber ma aha qol dhab ah ee waa hadal tusaale ah. Ka fikir waxa dhawaaqa dib u soo laabashadiisu ay ku dhigantahay internetka.
Ka fikir waxa si joogto ah dib ugu soo laabta sida dhawaaq, oo kala saar doorashooyinka ka hadlaya codka laftiisa iyo kuwa ka hadlaya fikirka dadka.

e-h3e-world-1.explanation: Jawaabtu waa luqad ay isticmaalaan dad afkooda hooyo kala duwan yahay. Doorka Ingiriisigu ku leeyahay xiriirka caalamiga ah waa tusaale. Luqad hal qoys oo keliya isticmaasho ma noqon karto luqad guud.
hints: Ha murugoon haddii erayada Laatiin aysan kuu caddayn. Marka hore is barbar dhig sida doorasho kasta u sharaxayso ‘yaa luqaddan isticmaala’, kadibna tirtir kuwa shuruud aad u cidhiidhi ah ama aan habboonayn leh.
Doorasho kasta ku is barbar dhig yaa luqadda isticmaala iyo xiriirkooda.

e-h3e-world-2.explanation: Jawaabtu waa stereotype. Waxay ka dhigan tahay aaminaad aad u fudud oo ku saabsan kooxda oo dhan. dialect waxay tilmaamaysaa lahjad gobol, sidaas darteed ma aha aaminaad ku saabsan dadka.
hints: Su'aasha macnaha, ka soo qaad erayada muhiimka ah. oversimplified iyo whole group ayaa fure ah.
Marka hore kala saar eray kasta in uu tilmaamayo fikir kooxeed, hadal, dhacdo mise qoys.

e-h3e-world-3.explanation: Jawaabtu waa diversity. cultural diversity waa kala duwanaansho dhaqameed. division macnaheedu waa ‘kala qaybin’, taas oo ka soo horjeeda sharaxaadda ‘waa wada nool yihiin’.
hints: Haddii erayadu isku eg yihiin higgaadda, is barbar dhig macnaha iyagoo adeegsanaya sharaxaadda ka dambaysa meesha madhan.
Is barbar dhig sharaxaadda ah dad asal kala duwan ku wada nool yihiin iyo macnaha magaca si dabiici ah u raaca cultural.

e-h3e-world-4.explanation: Jawaabtu waa Their customs are different from ours, and I would like to learn why. Waxay aqoonsataa kala duwanaanshaha waxayna rabtaa in wax laga barto. Erayo sida strange and backward waxay hoos u dhigaan dhaqanka dadka kale.
hints: Su'aasha xasaasiyadda dhaqameed waxay eegtaa in la xukumayo dhaqan kale mise la isku dayayo in la fahmo.
Hubi in ay ku jiraan erayo sida all, wrong, backward oo guud ka dhiga ama mid kale ka sarreeya.

e-h3e-world-5.explanation: Jawaabtu waa authentic. Macnaheedu waa ‘run ah, la aamini karo’. artificial waxay ka dhigan tahay wax qof sameeyey oo been ah, sidaas darteed waa ka soo horjeedaa.
hints: Erayga muhiimka ah ee sharaxaadda genuine ku beddel erayo fudud.
Ka fikir waxa ka soo horjeeda ‘not copied’, oo marka hore tirtir doorashada macnaha ka soo horjeeda.

e-h3e-world-d1.explanation: indigenous waxay la mid tahay wax asal ahaan goob ku nool, ay dhulkaas u gaar yihiin. foreign waa wax ka yimid waddan kale, sidaa darteed waa ka soo horjeeda.
hints: Akhri sharaxaadda oo qabo micnaha ugu muhiimsan, kadibna erey kasta u barbar dhig.
Tixgeli qaybta 'the first people who lived in a region'. Ereyada la xiriira moodada, xilliga, ama asalka, raadi kan micnahan ku habboon.

e-h3e-write-1.explanation: Jawaabtu waa makes. 'make a case for' waa collocation go'an oo ah 'u doodid taageero', sidaa darteed aad bay ugu habboon tahay xaaladda report-ku sababaha ku bixiyo. does waa fal guud, sidaa darteed kuma jirto 'a case for' oo wuu qalloocan yahay.
hints: Isku-xidhka fal iyo magac (collocation) waxaa lagu xasuustaa isku-xidh ahaan, ma aha micne. Xasuuso falka la isticmaalo case.
U barbar dhig falalka inta badan la socda case oo micnaheedu yahay in report-ku 'soo bandhigo' dood.

e-h3e-write-2.explanation: Jawaabtu waa Organized a school recycling campaign that collected 300 kilograms of paper. Waxay ku bilaabmaysaa fal oo muujisaa shaqada iyo natiijada tirada ah. Helped with various things ... ma sheegayso waxa la sameeyay.
hints: CV-gu wuxuu muujiyaa guulaha si gaar ah oo kooban. Ka fogow hadallo caddaysan.
U barbar dhig in doorasho kasta ay sheegayso hawlo gaar ah, mise ay tahay fikrad shakhsi ama sharaxaad aan cadayn.

e-h3e-write-3.explanation: Jawaabtu waa Although the museum was crowded, we stayed for three hours. Waa is-diidmo ah in dad badani jireen laakiin muddo dheer la joogay, sidaa darteed Although ayaa ku habboon. so we left after a short time waxay ka hor imanaysaa xaqiiqda muddada dheer la joogay.
hints: Marka laba jumladood la isku daro, marka hore go'aami xiriirka labada xaqiiqo (sabab, is-diidmo, waqti).
Ka fikir in dadkii badnaa iyo seddex saacadood joogista ay hal jihada u socdaan mise is-diidaan.

e-h3e-write-4.explanation: Jawaabtu waa The students who joined the club met every Friday. Mawduuca The students wuxuu leeyahay fal weyn met. Doorashada ku bilaabata Because waa subordinate clause, natiijaduna waa ka maqan tahay sidaa darteed ma dhammaystirna.
hints: Jumlad dhammaystiran waxay leedahay mawduuc iyo fal weyn oo micnuhu dhammaado. Ha ku khaldin relative clause, conjunction clause, ama -ing phrase.
Raadi in doorasho kasta ay leedahay fal weyn (waqti leh) oo jumladda weyn ah. Kala saar waxa ka dambeeya who ama because.

e-h3e-write-5.explanation: Jawaabtu waa an opinion letter to the board. Haddii ujeeddadu tahay ammaan-dhis, warqad ra'yi oo sabab bixisa ayaa ku habboon. diary entry waa diiwaan shakhsi, sidaa darteed ma aha qoraal ay ku qanciso guddiga dugsiga.
hints: Ujeeddada qoraalka (ammaan-dhis, macluumaad, diiwaan) iyo akhristuhu waxay go'aamiyaan nooca qoraalka.
Ka fikir yaa lagu weydiinayo maxay, kadibna raadi qaabka qoraalka ujeeddadaas loo isticmaalo.

e-h3e-write-d1.explanation: Marxaladda editing, waxaa lagu helaa lana saxaa khaladaadka naxwaha, higaadda, iyo calaamadaha qoraalka ee qoraal dhammaystiran. Ururinta fikradaha waa shaqada marxaladda brainstorming (prewriting), sidaa darteed way ka duwan tahay editing.
hints: Qoraalku wuxuu leeyahay marxalado isku xiga. Xasuuso waxa marxalad kasta lagu sameeyo (qorshayn, qoraal hore, dib-u-eegis, editing) oo dooro sharaxaadda editing.
editing waa marxalad la sameeyo marka qoraalku ku dhawaado dhammaad. Kala saar in doorasho kastaa tahay shaqo qoraalka ka hor ah mise qoraal dhammaaday la saxo.

e-m2-comp-1.prompt: Dooro erayga ku habboon meesha banaan: My bag is ____ than yours.
hints: Sifooyinka gaagaaban waxay isticmaalaan -er/-est, kuwa dhaadheer more/most. Marka wax la barbar dhigo isticmaal than.
Maadaama uu jiro than, waa comparative. heavy wuxuu u beddelmaa y → ier.

e-m2-comp-2.prompt: Dooro erayga ku habboon meesha banaan: This is the ____ movie I have ever seen.
hints: Sifooyinka gaagaaban waxay isticmaalaan -er/-est, kuwa dhaadheer more/most. Marka wax la barbar dhigo isticmaal than.
Waxay tahay 'kan ugu ... ee aan abid arkay', sidaa darteed waa superlative. interesting waa sifo dheer.

e-m2-comp-3.prompt: Dooro jumladda naxwe ahaan qalloocan (aan sax ahayn).
e-m2-comp-3.explanation: hotter than ayaa sax ah (t mar kale qor).
